This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The byte order mark is included by default so that spreadsheet applications correctly detect UTF-8 encoding when CSV files are opened directly. If you do not want the BOM, you can pass `bom: false` in the export options.
